title: Audit every CLAUDE.md rule: move what a tool or hook can carry, delete it from CLAUDE.md
notes:
Audit: move every remaining CLAUDE.md rule that a tool, a hook or the app can carry into that tool, and delete it from CLAUDE.md.

User's goal (2026-11-09): CLAUDE.md files hold as little as possible; the dashboard's tools (git, board, pane, the app's own session instructions, hooks) enforce or do the rest, without creating bugs.

Read ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (dotfiles), its rules/ files, the dashboard CLAUDE.md, and the seeded .dashboard/CLAUDE.md. For each rule, one row: keep (a judgement no tool can make, e.g. naming, honesty), move to a tool/hook/app instruction (say which, how it is enforced, what breaks if it fails), or delete (already enforced, e.g. by eslint or a test). Output: docs/workflow/claude-md-audit.md with the table, and one card per move on the board (high), ordered. No rule is deleted in this card.
